summary: Frontend-only regression of /demo-all visual-consistency fixes. Tested at mobile (430x900). PRESENCIA branch now renders the REAL LiveCardPreview inside PhoneFrame — verified by inspecting demo-interactive-mockup content: ES pill, CG initials avatar, brand name 'García Roofing', role line 'Roofing · Carlos García', four action buttons (Call/Text/WhatsApp/Email), and 'Save Contact' bar all present and visually polished. MARKETING branch DesignedPost renders inside Instagram-style card with: ROOFING + DONE RIGHT. two-line headline, TRUSTED LOCAL PRO ribbon, 5.0 rating pill, white brand chip 'García Roofing', amber FREE ESTIMATE pill + phone number, 214 likes, English caption, garcia_roofing username header, Copiar caption working. Branch selector (no deep link) shows all three options. Deep-links ?need=presencia and ?need=marketing both work. /demo regression: lead form -> describe step transition works. /tarjeta + Dashboard regression with cardonly_test@example.com: both load successfully, /tarjeta renders editor with LiveCardPreview action buttons (default id-based fallback path preserved). 27/27 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Same as iteration_22: DemoAll.js is now 647 lines (close to 700-line guideline). DesignedPost was added inline. Recommend splitting into /pages/DemoAll/index.js + ./branches/{Negocio,Presencia,Marketing}.jsx + ./shared/{ModuleUpsell,BackBar,FeatureRow,DesignedPost}.jsx for maintainability.

MarketingBranch hardcodes Houston/'Houston & surrounding areas' in caption + 'Houston, TX' in IG header. If a non-Houston lead trade is supported in future, parametrize from lead.city. Acceptable for now (Houston launch market).
DesignedPost.lead prop is passed but only lead.phone is used; safe to simplify signature to (meta, name, phone, headline).
Marketing simulated setTimeout(2200ms) in generate() still has no cleanup if user navigates away mid-loader. Low impact.
Lint: top of DemoAll.js still imports `useEffect` (unused) and `Smartphone` (verify usage).

LiveCardPreview.js change is clean: optional card.profile_photo_url/logo_photo_url/cover_photo_url override the id-based URLs while id-based fallback is preserved (lines 65-67). No regression in /tarjeta or dashboard preview verified visually.
Anti-abuse cap on /api/public/demo/quote (Negocio branch real-AI) was NOT exercised this run to avoid IP cap; agent note confirms expected behavior.
test_credentials: cardonly_test@example.com / Test1234 (used for /tarjeta + dashboard regression). No login needed for /demo or /demo-all.
